# Test that internally linking cgo bindings records -Wl,-rpath and -Wl,-R
# entries from #cgo LDFLAGS in DT_RUNPATH, without duplicates, and that
# -ldflags=-r takes precedence.

env origGOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT
env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[!GOOS:linux] skip
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip

# Build the pure-Go ELF checker under the host GOEXPERIMENT in parallel so
# debug/elf reuses the warm GOCACHE instead of rebuilding under cgobindings.
env GOEXPERIMENT=$origGOEXPERIMENT
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -o checkrunpath$GOEXE ./runpath &

env GOEXPERIMENT=$origGOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
env CC=/bin/false
go build -ldflags=-linkmode=internal -o prog.exe ./prog
go build -ldflags='-linkmode=internal -r /explicit' -o prog2.exe ./prog

wait
exec ./checkrunpath$GOEXE prog.exe prog2.exe
stdout '^prog\.exe: /opt/cgo-rpath-a:/opt/cgo-rpath-b:/opt/cgo-rpath-c$'
stdout '^prog2\.exe: /explicit$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/rpath

go 1.27
-- prog/main.go --
package main

// #cgo LDFLAGS: -Wl,-rpath,/opt/cgo-rpath-a -Wl,-rpath -Wl,/opt/cgo-rpath-b
// #cgo LDFLAGS: -Wl,-R,/opt/cgo-rpath-c -Wl,-rpath,/opt/cgo-rpath-a
import "C"

//cgo:func getpid getpid libc
func getpid() int32

func main() {
	println(getpid())
}
-- runpath/main.go --
package main

import (
	"debug/elf"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	for _, arg := range os.Args[1:] {
		f, err := elf.Open(arg)
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		s, err := f.DynString(elf.DT_RUNPATH)
		f.Close()
		if err != nil {
			log.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Printf("%s: %s\n", arg, strings.Join(s, "\n"))
	}
}
